relations.evidence: ADR 0024 note (2026-10-07): "Owning the agent loop is no longer deferred. The engine builds its own runtime in stages behind this seam ... see ADR 0045. Items 1 (the seam), 2, 3 and 5 stand; item 4 holds while ADK is a runtime."
relations.note: In part: supersedes the deferral of owning the agent loop and ADK as the lasting runtime; the seam, turn-wide controls, boundary suite and A2A stance stand.

relations.evidence: ADR 0046 Consequences: "The GPT, Grok and Kimi adapters carry their reasoning state through the same field under their own provider ids (openai, xai, moonshot)."
ADR 0046 Decision, Storage: "trimEventForStorage and the session services keep the field whole; the transcript projection drops it with the rest of a past turn."

skills/melchizedek-models/SKILL.md "Settings per agent" restates ADR 0047 Decision 2 (thinking level, thinking budget 0/2048/8192/16384, effort word) and Decision 6 (thinkingConfig and reasoningEffort as the older spelling); skills/melchizedek-author/assets/minimal.yaml sets reasoning:. A change to the mapping changes those shipped skills and their briefs.
ADR 0047 maps reasoning: none on Ollama to reasoning_effort "none", the one value ADR 0027 found Ollama's /v1 endpoint honours; the model zoo's qwen_local relies on it.
ADR 0047: "high stops at 16,384 because the Claude adapter raises max_tokens to at least the budget plus 2,048", keeping a non-streaming request under the Anthropic SDK ceiling.

/operations/parity-harness.md: "`npm run parity` (`scripts/parity_check.ts`) answers one question per provider: does the engine's core work end to end on it? ... A runtime gate is a run of this script, not a manual check."

/memory/architecture.md, Stored event shape: "With `--check` it exits 1 when a fixture no longer matches what the runtime writes, which is what a dependency bump that changes the stored shape looks like. `npm run fixtures:sessions:check` runs that check, and CI's test job runs it after the offline suite on both Node versions."
relations.note: The script runs tests/fixtures/sessions/generate.ts --check; the build links scripts only to source modules, so this edge is asserted.

relations.evidence: ADR 0048 Decision 3: "ReasoningSetting moves from the loader to the contract, and lib/loadSyndicate.ts imports and re-exports it, so the dependency points from the loader to the contract."
ADR 0048 Decision 2: "The module is types only, its one import is ProviderState, and no module in its import graph names @google/*."
ADR 0045 Decision 1: "The model contract is the engine's own message format, with a slot for the provider-opaque reasoning state that @google/genai Content cannot carry." ADR 0048 is that contract.
ADR 0048 Decision 1: "Any part may carry providerState, reusing ADR 0046's type."
ADR 0048 Decision 3: ReasoningSetting (ADR 0047) belongs to the contract, and "Each adapter maps the setting itself, so a fallback model gets its own mapping."

ADR 0050 Decision: reasoning ids "send store: false and include: ['reasoning.encrypted_content']"; each run of reasoning items rides verbatim on the part after it and is replayed before that part within the turn's tool loop.
ADR 0050 Decision, Which ids: "xAI's grok-4.5 and grok-4.7, through the adapter hook replaysReasoning()". Other grok ids send nothing new.
ADR 0050 Decision, Replay: "currentTurnStart in lib/models/providerState.ts holds that rule for every adapter."

ADR 0046 Consequences: "The GPT, Grok and Kimi adapters carry their reasoning state through the same field under their own provider ids (openai, xai, moonshot)." /models/provider-routing.md: "Kimi turns the hook on for the ids Moonshot's thinking-model guide asks it of within a tool loop".

/models/provider-routing.md: "The chat-completions base (lib/models/openAiCompatibleLlm.ts) carries reasoning_content behind one opt-in hook, replaysReasoningContent(), off by default ... sends it back as that assistant message's reasoning_content on the current turn's tool loop, for the same provider and model only."

ADR 0044 Decision, The breaker: "Per provider, shared by every wrapped agent in the process: MODEL_BREAKER_THRESHOLD consecutive failures (default 5; 0 disables) open it for MODEL_BREAKER_COOLDOWN_MS (default 30 s)". circuitBreaker.ts holds that state for FallbackLlm and FallbackAdapter alike.

ADR 0044 Decision, What redirects: only a provider-side failure that retry.ts classifies retryable, "redirected only if the primary had produced nothing yet"; a 4xx, a canceled turn and a stream that failed midway are never redirected. FallbackAdapter applies these to a failed final's error.retryable and status.

ADR 0048 Decision 4: "A failure is a final with error set, never a throw" and "a cancellation is never retryable"; Decision 5: "retryable decides whether a fallback answers"; Decision 3: "Each adapter maps the setting itself, so a fallback model gets its own mapping."

ADR 0045, decision 4: the stored Event JSON in adk_sessions.events never changes without an ADR; its note (2026-10-07): "The stored Event JSON in item 4 carries an elided tool result's size inside its marker text. trimEventForStorage (lib/session/transcript.ts) now writes that size with en-US digit grouping".

ADR 0048 Consequences: "Lowercase JSON Schema is the one dialect inside the contract. A schema in Gemini's uppercase dialect is converted once, where it enters, instead of by every adapter." contractToolDeclaration and toContractJsonSchema are that conversion.
ADR 0049 §4: "Rows not bound to the conversation replay as ADR 0046 says"; on bound rows the same replay rides under drop_block, closing ADR 0046's named gap for resumed turns.

ADR 0049 §4 and Context: trimEventForStorage elides tool results over 2,000 characters and JSONB reorders keys, so a resumed turn differs from what the model saw; drop_block makes the API drop a changed block instead of failing, and "The session stores do not change."
ADR 0049 §2: "This supersedes ADR 0047's statement that the Claude adapter never reads the effort word: on the adaptive rows it is the only thing it reads."
relations.note: In part: only how the Claude adapter reads the reasoning fields. ADR 0047's key, levels and compiler mapping stand.

relations.evidence: ADR 0051 §1 and §4: "The module imports only a type from the model contract" and "tool.ts and toolContract.ts load nothing from @google/* at runtime"; tests/toolContract.test.ts asserts it.

ADR 0051 §4: "lib/tools/adkTool.ts holds toFunctionTool(tool)", the one place a Tool becomes an ADK FunctionTool, and §5: it keeps ADK's approval texts and long-running note so both runtimes store the same events.
ADR 0051 §3: "defineTool returns a Tool that is still a ToolContract", whose execute validates the arguments before the handler runs; §4: toolContract.ts no longer exports toFunctionTool.
ADR 0051 §1: "declaration() returns the model contract's ToolDeclaration", the type ADR 0048 defines in lib/models/contract.ts.
